    35	universe u

    37	namespace Jacobson

    39	/-- The Jacobson conjecture for a ring $R$: the infimum of the powers of the Jacobson radical
    40	$J$ is the zero ideal. -/
    41	def JacobsonConjectureFor (R : Type u) [Ring R] : Prop :=
    42	  ⨅ n : ℕ, jacobson R ^ n = 0
    43	
    44	/-- The Jacobson conjecture (in its modern form):
    45	In a (noncommutative) ring which is left and right Noetherian,
    46	the intersection of the powers of the Jacobson ideal is trivial -/
    47	@[category research open, AMS 16]
    48	theorem jacobson_conjecture :
    49	    answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ (R : Type) [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsRightNoetherianRing R],
    50	      JacobsonConjectureFor R := by
    51	  sorry
    52	
    53	/-- For commutative rings this is the case as a consequence of Krull's intersection theorem. -/
    54	@[category textbook, AMS 13 16]
    55	theorem jacobson_conjecture_of_comm_ring (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    56	    JacobsonConjectureFor R := by
